answer: Replication cost is charged up front and burned if an account the payer recruited misbehaves, so a farm cannot walk away from a bad batch. Concretely, register five siblings from one test account and let one fail an audit: the original's bond burns with it. Trust sits on the finished task, so an honest agent that wanders between labels keeps its record while a mirror of shale test accounts shares one failure instead of pooling credit.
